Very dry biryani. No taste in the rice or the gravy. Only Chicken kabab was good. For such a good location, they can do better

I don't know why some of them are not satisfied with the food here. I also checked the Google rating and personally verified with locals (family); everyone said it's good. Fine , I took away some food items like Tandoori chicken, butter naan, roti, mushroom curry, dal fry, and kushka rice. All dishes were good, and so far our stomachs are safe. Prices are not too high like those at other North Indian dhabas. They have outstanding vibes with colorful lights. As for hygiene, yes, they should get upgraded.
Not recommended for mutton biryani....
This is a decent place to eat in a small town like Chikballapur. It has a dhaba like atmosphere inside. Food was average.
